{{cleanup}} {{CharInfobox| color={{Black color}} | corecolor={{Electric color light}} | bordercolor={{Poison color}} | text=white | name=Rowena | jname=リオカ| tmname=Rioka | slogan=no |image=Rowena.png | size=100px | caption=Rowena | gender=Female | hometown=Unknown | region=[[Sinnoh]] | relatives=Unknown| trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M13| epname=Zoroark: Master of Illusions| enva=[[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]]| java=Natsuki Katō | }} '''Rowena''' (Japanese: '''リオカ''' ''Rioka'') is a major character who appeared in ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ==History== At the beginning of the film, Rowena appears as [[Grings Kodai]]'s secretary. Though intelligent, she is timid and easily frightened; during a demonstration of {{OBP|Zoroark|M13}}'s abilities, she needs to be reassured by her boss that Zoroark's attacks are only {{a|illusion}}s and reminded that she possesses an "Illusion Canceler" device like Kodai himself and [[Goone]] do. She later accompanies Kodai and Goone into [[Crown City]] to hunt for {{OBP|Celebi|M13}}. Kodai assigns the two of them to thwart the foreseen interference of {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} while he examines the city's [[Pokémon Baccer World Cup]] countdown clocks in his search for the [[Time Ripple]]. [[File:Rowena hair down.png|thumb|220px|left|Rowena not in disguise]] When the duo finds Ash and his friends, Goone leaves Rowena to deal with them while he returns to aid Kodai. It is here that she reveals her true identity: she removes her glasses, lets down her hair, and reveals that she is actually a reporter and colleague of [[Karl]], working undercover to reveal Kodai's secrets. With her help, the group is able to hack into Kodai's computer network and determine the last countdown clock he has not yet checked, allowing them to race to its location in an attempt to stop him. She is later seen at the Pokémon Baccer Stadium with Karl watching as Ash faces off against Kodai. Kodai reveals that he knew Rowena would be a traitor all along, thanks to a vision of the future that he had. Along with Karl, she later publishes the story exposing Kodai's scheme and his imprisonment. She is last seen sailing off to Unova with Karl, {{OBP|Zorua|M13}}, and Zoroark accompanying her. ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{electric color light}}; background: #{{black color}};" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{poison color}}; background: #{{black color}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:Sugimori Rowena anime.png|200px]] |- | [[Ken Sugimori]]'s design of Rowena |} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{black color}}|bordercolor={{electric color light}} |ja=加藤夏希 ''Natsuki Katō'' |en=[[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]] |fi=Annituuli Kasurinen |de=Nina Kapust |it=Francesca Bielli |pl=Izabella Bukowska |es_eu=Margot Lago |es_la=Carla Castañeda |pt_br=Adriana Pissardini}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{black color}}; border: 3px solid #{{electric color}}" |- style="text-align:center" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | {{color|FFF|Language}} ! {{color|FFF|Name}} ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | {{color|FFF|Origin}} |- style="background:#FFF;" | Japanese | リオカ ''Rioka'' | |- style="background:#FFF;" | English, European Spanish,
